after.note: The later camera regression and documentation do not change production source.

measurementContract.counterFrameScope: sortInputs delta covers all 45 control frames (15 warmup + 30 measured) and counts ECS FractionalIndex events observed by Sort; Core has no FractionalIndex system.
measurementContract.timingScope: Controls retain existing native/glyph/order probes but do not install optional phase wrappers. Profiled phases follow controls and retain their existing exclusive synchronous wall-time boundaries. Calls include cached/empty early returns; small times can round to zero. No GPU timestamps or calibrated observer overhead.
measurementContract.summaryScope: All CPU/native samples, resource snapshots, phase aggregates, coverage and three slowest profiled frames are retained. Only the full profiled.phaseSamples arrays are omitted; the unchanged bench:edit-phases command regenerates complete files.
measurementContract.limits: One serial before/after software WebGL cohort; no stable FPS multiplier or causal tail-latency conclusion. Core production code is unchanged and its variation is a control.
